meta.title: A Little Further
meta.audience: My family and relatives in Ethiopia and the diaspora, watching on a phone in WhatsApp/Telegram; secondary: peers and colleagues on LinkedIn/Slack. The film is also a tribute to my late mother.
meta.intent: At the end, viewers feel that one person's achievement is the accumulated sacrifice of many generations, and that the story is not finished: it is the narrator's turn to carry the family a little further.
meta.logline: Four generations, from a tailor on Harar's street of sewing machines to an AI engineer in Addis Ababa, each giving up something so the next could go a little further.
meta.style_block: Painterly hand-painted illustration, soft gouache and oil textures with visible brush strokes, gentle film grain, warm earthy palette of ochre, sienna, deep green and muted indigo, soft natural light, dignified, humane and intimate, cinematic composition with the subject centred, no text, no letters, no signage, no watermark.
meta.negative_prompt: photorealistic, archival photograph, sepia photo, Moroccan medina, horseshoe arches, zellige tiles, domes, minarets on every roof, palm trees, adobe, readable signs or text, hyena, exoticised or voyeuristic framing, extra fingers, distorted hands
